[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31095607/4dcd5a5e1ae68ec25a7c2647285dea984d35e5b2.png"][/img][/p][p]We would like to inform all hero players that the updated
appearance change system will be applied on July 31, 2025.

In order to provide a more diverse and refreshed character
customization experience, we will be patching
the existing appearance system.[/p][p][/p][h2] [b]□ Appearance Change Update  [/b][/h2][p]- Some parts of the appearance change system will be updated. 
└ A new Appearance Change Shop has been added in the Dragon Castle / Xian, Sina NPC. 
└ Appearance changes cannot be applied to time-limited items. 
└ Once an appearance is changed, the item will become \[[b]Cannot trade or store[/b]].
└ If the appearance change is reset, the restrictions on
   \[[b]Cannot trade or store[/b]] will be lifted.
└ Appearance items can be dismantled.
└ Appearances can be applied regardless of character class
   (Non-Divine, Divine, Darkness).
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31095607/6e0a3f1c09a8a914bcba493eb5be5faf6925260e.png"][/img][/p][p]▲ Dragon Castle, NPC Sina
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31095607/4f44bd686feb3602b2285e12fa9ef662a87d8c61.png"][/img][/p][p]▲ Xian, NPC Sina
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31095607/235145808c5ce6fddae03d71553cd72605dca011.png"][/img]

notes.title: [Re-patch] Steam Old Client Error Issue
notes.notes:
Dear Heroes Community,

We have identified an issue with the 'old client error' occurring on Steam accounts that have been inactive for an extended period.

Typically, if a Steam account has not received game updates for about six months, an 'old client error' message appears, and in such cases, we recommend reinstalling the game.

However, we have identified error issues with the reinstall client and are working to address this.

The Steam client's re-installation files will be updated on the upcoming maintenance date, September 14th.

[b][Steam Client Patch Maintenance][/b]
[b]September 14th, 2023.[/b]


We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

Regards,
Hero Team

notes.title: 2020/10/28 Halloween Update Notice
notes.notes:
Halloween Event

  As the horrors of the Corona virus arises in October. We shall continuously end the 5th year anniversary and bring the horrors of Halloween to the Hero Community! We are finally at Halloween and to celebrate this year’s Halloween we decided to add a bit of spice to the Hero Community. This will be done by bringing back old HT Set and allowing you to decorate your current sets with Illusion water. Not only this we have added a new boss monster to kill to receive rewards. To finally top off the hat we are adding new items to the HT box & a new map to really grind in the horrors within you! Please check the listed information below for details.

 
1)     Check in Event – Nothing drastically different but log in and check in to receive your rewards.

2)    New Map – A new map introducing “Dark Map”. A map that allows you to grind harder. However, there is new specific rules here. You will receive extra EXP than normal maps. But the monsters are stronger. We are providing payed Buffs to help you within this!
There is a big secret to the stats happening in “Dark Night”. Detail information will be provided soon. Not only this the drops will be a lot special differing from the other maps.
Grinding this map will allow you to gain access to new items / gold.

3)    Bounty Buff – We’ve been receiving a lot of interest in Bounty. We have brought it back to Hero Plus. Enjoy the paid purge system that is happening. Also, this update to protect from the mass murders we are adding a buff protection system also. We will put a bounty protection (PKing Proof) buff to hinder other from killing you. Let’s try to keep this Halloween frightful but safe and fun from all the kills and murder that may happen! 😊

4)    New Update on HT and Items – We have received a lot of interest in new HT Items that will help you decorate your items. We are introducing older HT sets to help you decorate your current armor’s with Holy Illusion Water. Therefore, try to enjoy a diversity of looks.

5)    Boss Monster / The Tree of Horror – A random boss monster will appear on CI for at a designated time to receive a box reward that can be claimed. Gather in groups of numbers
and receive the rewards from claiming the kills of the monster.
 

Hero Team has tried their best to allow a better and a diverse experience to help out the community and bring new contents in.

Really do hope you guys are pumped up about this and surely hope you will enjoy it.

Thanks

-Hero Team

Thank you for all your patience. 
We are finally getting a new update to celebrate our 5th year Anniversary for Hero Plus. We have arranged new things for this Anniversary to give back to the loyal supporters of our Hero Plus game. We’ve listened to your opinions and decided to reflect on your thoughts and needs for this patch.

notes.title: Steam Payment Policy Update
notes.notes:
Dear Hero Plus community!

We have important announcement to make about our Steam payment system. 

In an effort to avoid chargeback issue that we have received recently, we will be changing the conditions of Steam payment.

Players will now have to meet the following conditions in order to avoid any potential nCash Chargeback abuse,
 
- Player Level 75 or more will be able to purchase nCash through Steam
- Player Level less than 75 will not be able to purchase nCash through Steam

Much appreciate your kind understanding of change in Steam payment policy.

Regards
Shadow
